title: have you seen this domino
author: Hempelson Tamsova
rules:
solve with SudokuPad

Rules

Normal Sudoku rules apply. Every row in the grid is divided into three segments by the vertical box borders. Each segment contains a set of the digits 147, 258 or 369.

Dots:

- digits seperated by a white dot are consecutive and all possible dots are given.

- digits seperated by a black dot have a 1:2 ratio and not all dots are given. Infact EXACTLY six black dots are missing.

No black dot is hiding beneath a white dot and vice versa.

Cages: All cages function as a giant Killer Cage which sums to 45 and has no repeating digits.

Additionally, six of the caged cells will see exactly one digit of the missing black dot dominoes by its surroundings (Kings move in chess) and each of these dominoes will be seen by exactly one caged cell.

Three cages are imposters and its digit DOES NOT see any cell appearing on a missing dot (Kings move). There will be exactly one imposter cage for each horizontal set of boxes (box 123, 456, 789)

Digits in a cage may be part of a missing domino.

P.s. Since this is my first ever puzzle i hope my clarifications are appropiate and for your enjoyment, i hope the puzzle has a unique solution (which i'm quite sure of). If not, please let me know!
solutionCode: type in every central digit of each box in numerical order (from low to high, 9 digits, no spaces inbetween)
